notes.title: System maintenance announcement on May 12
notes.content:
Dear Players:

In order to improve the service quality, Wangyuan's platform center will carry out system upgrade and maintenance from [b]May 12th from 1:00 am to 13:00 pm (UTC+8)[/b].

During the maintenance period, the game functions will be affected and you cannot log in to the game.

If the maintenance content cannot be completed within the scheduled time, we will extend the maintenance time as appropriate and notify players in time.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and thank you for your patience and understanding!

Happy gaming everyone!


Wangyuan Shengtang Operation Team
May 11, 2022
